channel.title: UK Defence Journal - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from UK Defence Journal (ukdefencejournal.org.uk)

item.title: Protector drone still short of IOC despite deployment
item.description: The Ministry of Defence has confirmed that the MQ-9B Protector has not yet reached Initial Operating Capability, despite the original estimate that this would take place in 2025. The post Protector drone still short of IOC despite deployment first appeared on UK Defence Journal.

item.title: NATO carried out 500 air intercepts in 2025
item.description: NATO air forces carried out more than 500 scrambles during 2025 as part of the Alliance air policing mission, according to figures released by Allied Air Command. The post NATO carried out 500 air intercepts in 2025 first appeared on UK Defence Journal.

item.title: Update given on British destroyer missile upgrade
item.description: The Sea Viper Evolution programme for the Type 45 Destroyer fleet is expected to deliver an initial ballistic missile defence capability in the early 2030s, according to a new parliamentary answer. The post Update given on British destroyer missile upgrade first appeared on UK Defence Journal.

item.title: Royal Navy tests helicopter-led drone targeting in UK first
item.description: Royal Navy Wildcat helicopters have for the first time used live data from multiple uncrewed systems to identify and target a moving vehicle during trials in the UK. The post Royal Navy tests helicopter-led drone targeting in UK first first appeared on UK Defence Journal.

item.title: Historic Manchester steel firm lays off more than 100 staff
item.description: More than 100 workers at a Manchester steel fabrication company with roots in the Second World War have been laid off, with staff told they would receive no working hours through December and into January. The post Historic Manchester steel firm lays off more than 100 staff first appeared on UK Defence Journal.

item.title: RAF-led Project BOYD to explore AI-driven planning
item.description: Project BOYD is a Royal Air Force-led initiative focused on using artificial intelligence to accelerate and improve military command and control decision-making. The post RAF-led Project BOYD to explore AI-driven planning first appeared on UK Defence Journal.

item.title: Massive US air build-up across Europe and Middle East
item.description: A surge in US military air activity across Europe and the Middle East is underway alongside rising tensions with Iran, with open-source tracking showing increased tanker, transport, and support aircraft movements over recent days. The post Massive US air build-up across Europe and Middle East first appeared on UK Defence Journal.

item.title: Hawk to receive upgraded cockpit software under new contract
item.description: The Ministry of Defence has awarded a contract worth up to GBP 2.5 million to Inzpire Ltd to upgrade mission support systems used on the RAF Hawk T1 aircraft. The post Hawk to receive upgraded cockpit software under new contract first appeared on UK Defence Journal.

item.title: Seven arrested in UK during global people-smuggling crackdown
item.description: Seven people have been arrested in the United Kingdom as part of an international operation targeting people smuggling and human trafficking networks, led by INTERPOL and coordinated domestically by the National Crime Agency. The post Seven arrested in UK during global people-smuggling crackdown first appeared on UK Defence Journal.

item.title: UK to study Aster 30 integration for Mk41 missile launcher
item.description: The Ministry of Defence has awarded a contract to MBDA UK to examine the feasibility of integrating the Mk41 Vertical Launching System with the Aster 30 missile. The post UK to study Aster 30 integration for Mk41 missile launcher first appeared on UK Defence Journal.
